title: The Curse of the Cannibal Ghost of the Haunted House on Horror Hill
description: A creature feature about a cannibal ghost. He’ll scare you to death… and then eat your ghost!
quote: What is that up ahead? That haunted house on that horrible looking hill!
altHero: car approaching a hill with a spooky looking house
alt1: man and woman driving in the car
alt2: woman holds onto the man as a scary old farmer holds a pitchfork
alt3: creepy farmer holds up long, spindly fingers
